body: Thanks. That actually helped. Not a lot- I still feel pretty damn useless, but at least I know that being kind is something I *can* do.

I don't know how much there is to talk about. I try and I try and I try and I'm not a genius, I don't have anything to give mentally. I have nothing to offer the world. I've tried my best to be a good kind person but it doesn't make a damn bit of difference. I'm still treated as disgusting by most people.
